read_slice_file: read a slice of a seekable file-like object using SliceFileObj with a specified offset and byte limit
create_slice_file_obj: create a SliceFileObj context manager to read a bounded slice from a binary file
test_slice_file_obj: test the SliceFileObj class to verify it correctly slices and reads file content
refactor_slice_file_obj: refactor the SliceFileObj class to support additional whence modes in the seek method
review_slice_file_obj: review the SliceFileObj class and its read, tell, and seek methods for correctness
